hebrewText: וּ/לְבָנ֕וֹן אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י בָּעֵ֑ר וְ/חַיָּת֔/וֹ אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י עוֹלָֽה

tokens.bdb: Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).

tokens.bdb: enough (as noun or adverb), used chiefly with preposition in phrases
tokens.kjv: able, according to, after (ability), among, as (oft as), (more than) enough, from, in, since, (much as is) sufficient(-ly), too much, very, when.

tokens.bdb: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating);  to be(-come) brutish
tokens.kjv: be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste.

tokens.bdb: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.
tokens.explanation: chai — vivo, vivente, ser que tem vida
